components.name: Button
components.description: Default boxed button: paper fill, printed-rule stroke.
components.css: .ds-btn{appearance:none;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:40px;padding:0 16px;border:1px solid var(--rule-strong,#3d8fa8);border-radius:0;background:var(--paper,#eef1ea);color:var(--ink,#1b1f1d);font:600 17px/1 var(--font-form,"Barlow Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif);letter-spacing:.02em;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .15s,transform .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-btn:hover{background:var(--paper-2,#e2e8df)}.ds-btn:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#2d5fb8);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Ink Button
components.description: Primary action for everything except resuming.
components.css: .ds-btn-ink{appearance:none;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:40px;padding:0 16px;border:1px solid var(--ink,#1b1f1d);border-radius:0;background:var(--ink,#1b1f1d);color:var(--paper,#eef1ea);font:600 17px/1 var(--font-form,"Barlow Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif);letter-spacing:.02em;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .15s,transform .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-btn-ink:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink,#1b1f1d) 82%,var(--rule-strong,#3d8fa8))}.ds-btn-ink:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-btn-ink:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#2d5fb8);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Resume Button
components.description: Red pencil fill; only for Resume / Jump to the stop mark.
components.css: .ds-btn-resume{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:52px;padding:0 22px;border:1px solid var(--red,#d23a2c);border-radius:0;background:var(--red,#d23a2c);color:var(--on-red,#fff);font:600 20px/1 var(--font-form,"Barlow Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif);letter-spacing:.02em;text-decoration:none;transition:background-color .15s,transform .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-btn-resume:hover{background:var(--red-ink,#b52c20);border-color:var(--red-ink,#b52c20)}.ds-btn-resume:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-btn-resume:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#2d5fb8);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Filter Field
components.description: Boxed field; the whole cell rings blue on focus.
components.html: <label class="ds-filter"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="m20 20-3.5-3.5"/></svg><input placeholder="Filter series"></label>

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Ruled cells; selected takes print cyan with a printed underline.
components.css: .ds-seg{display:inline-flex;border:1px solid var(--rule-strong,#3d8fa8);background:var(--paper,#eef1ea)}.ds-seg button{appearance:none;border:0;background:none;cursor:pointer;padding:0 14px;min-height:40px;font:600 16px/1 var(--font-form,"Barlow Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif);color:var(--ink-2,#48514c)}.ds-seg button+button{border-left:1px solid var(--rule-strong,#3d8fa8)}.ds-seg button[aria-checked="true"]{background:var(--print,#cfe5ea);color:var(--ink,#1b1f1d);box-shadow:inset 0 -3px 0 var(--rule-strong,#3d8fa8)}.ds-seg button:hover:not([aria-checked="true"]){background:var(--paper-2,#e2e8df)}.ds-seg button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#2d5fb8);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Provider Tag
components.description: Boxed provider link with its last mono time.
components.css: .ds-prov{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:4px 8px;border:1px solid var(--rule-strong,#3d8fa8);background:var(--paper,#eef1ea);color:var(--ink,#1b1f1d);text-decoration:none;font:13px/1.5 var(--font-body,Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif)}.ds-prov span{font:500 12px var(--font-time,"JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace);color:var(--ink-3,#5c6560);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-prov:hover{border-color:var(--ink,#1b1f1d);background:var(--print,#cfe5ea)}.ds-prov:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#2d5fb8);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Title Block
components.description: Printed header: print-cyan cells, each label naming the value beneath it.
components.html:
SeriesKumotstamp
Marks14
components.css: .ds-tb{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 110px;background:var(--print,#cfe5ea);border-bottom:2px solid var(--rule-strong,#3d8fa8);color:var(--ink,#1b1f1d)}.ds-tb-cell{padding:10px 20px 12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}.ds-tb-cell+.ds-tb-cell{border-left:1px solid var(--rule-strong,#3d8fa8)}.ds-tb-label{font:600 11px/1.1 var(--font-form,"Barlow Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--rule-ink,#23677d)}.ds-tb-name{font:700 36px/.95 var(--font-form,"Barlow Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif);letter-spacing:-.015em}.ds-tb-val{font:700 30px/1 var(--font-time,"JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;letter-spacing:-.03em}

components.name: Episode Row
components.description: Episode box, ruler and red-ink timecode in a ruled table row.
components.css: .ds-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;gap:16px;align-items:center;padding:12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule,#a9cfd9);background:var(--paper,#eef1ea)}.ds-ep{min-width:44px;padding:5px 6px;text-align:center;border:1px solid var(--rule-strong,#3d8fa8);font:700 15px/1 var(--font-time,"JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--ink,#1b1f1d)}.ds-time{font:700 18px/1 var(--font-time,"JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--red-ink,#b52c20)}.ds-rr{position:relative;height:26px;border:1px solid var(--rule-strong,#3d8fa8);background:repeating-linear-gradient(to right,var(--rule-strong,#3d8fa8) 0 1px,transparent 1px calc(100% / var(--minutes) * 5)) bottom/100% 12px no-repeat,repeating-linear-gradient(to right,var(--rule,#a9cfd9) 0 1px,transparent 1px calc(100% / var(--minutes))) bottom/100% 7px no-repeat,linear-gradient(to right,var(--red-wash,#f6dcd6) calc(var(--pos) * 100%),transparent 0),var(--paper,#eef1ea)}.ds-rr span{position:absolute;top:-6px;bottom:-6px;left:calc(var(--pos) * 100%);width:3px;margin-left:-1.5px;background:var(--red,#d23a2c);border-radius:1.5px}

components.name: Ruler
components.description: Signature instrument: minute ticks, 5-minute heavy ticks, red pencil mark; click or arrow keys move the mark.
components.css: .ds-ruler-xl{position:relative;height:44px;margin:12px 0;cursor:crosshair;border:1px solid var(--rule-strong,#3d8fa8);background:repeating-linear-gradient(to right,var(--rule-strong,#3d8fa8) 0 1px,transparent 1px calc(100% / var(--minutes) * 5)) bottom/100% 12px no-repeat,repeating-linear-gradient(to right,var(--rule,#a9cfd9) 0 1px,transparent 1px calc(100% / var(--minutes))) bottom/100% 7px no-repeat,linear-gradient(to right,var(--red-wash,#f6dcd6) calc(var(--pos) * 100%),transparent 0),var(--paper,#eef1ea)}.ds-ruler-xl span{position:absolute;top:-10px;bottom:-10px;left:calc(var(--pos) * 100%);width:5px;margin-left:-2.5px;background:var(--red,#d23a2c);border-radius:1.5px;transform-origin:50% 100%;animation:ds-pencil .7s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both}.ds-ruler-xl:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#2d5fb8);outline-offset:3px}@keyframes ds-pencil{from{transform:scaleY(0)}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-ruler-xl span{animation:none}}

narrative.overview:
Progress is drawn on an anime studio timesheet. Each series is a sheet, each episode a ruled row, and the place you stopped is a red-pencil mark on a minute ruler. The page is printed stationery that someone has written on: pale green-grey stock, cyan rules and header cells printed by the form, ink type, and two pencils that carry all the meaning. Red marks where you stopped. Blue marks what you finished.

Density is that of a working form, not a showcase. Everything sits in square boxed cells divided by printed rules on a 24px row pitch. Numbers are the content, so timecodes and episode numbers are set in a tabular monospace and allowed to get monumental (the Continue band timecode reaches 112px). Labels are small condensed caps printed in the form's cyan ink, the way 作品名 / 話数 / カット boxes are labelled on a real sheet.

The night sheet is the same form re-printed in phosphor cyan on blue-black stock. It appears only when the OS asks for dark, for the library or popup opened beside a playing video at night. Paper stays the canonical ground; the night sheet keeps every rule, cell and pencil role. The world refuses the streaming-app grid of poster cards on a dark ground.
keyCharacteristics: Pale green-grey sheet paper, never cream, ruled in cyan on a 24px pitch.
Cyan print fill marks what the form printed: title-block cells and table heads.
Two pencils carry meaning: red for the stop, blue for finished.
Square boxed cells everywhere; no rounded cards.
Tabular monospace for every timecode and episode number; condensed caps for form labels.
The minute ruler is the signature instrument.

rules.name: The Two Pencils Rule
rules.body: Red is the stop mark and nothing else: the ruler mark and its wash, timecodes, and the Resume / Jump action. Blue is finished. Neither pencil is used for decoration, emphasis, or branding.

rules.name: The Printed Form Rule
rules.body: Cyan belongs to the form, not to the user. Anything the sheet "printed" (header cells, table heads, labels, rules) is cyan; anything the viewer "wrote" is ink or pencil.

rules.name: The Not-Cream Rule
rules.body: The paper is pale green-grey (`sheet-paper`). Warm cream or white grounds break the sheet.

rules.name: The Mono Is For Numbers Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono sets timecodes, episode numbers, counts and time inputs only. Words never go in mono.

rules.name: The Printed Label Rule
rules.body: Form labels are 11px condensed caps in rule ink and always label a value in the same cell (Series, Marks, Episode, Stopped at). They name a field on the sheet. They are never a decorative line above a heading.

rules.name: The Paper Lift Rule
rules.body: Only a sheet of paper lifts. Cells, buttons and inputs are flat and get their edge from a printed rule.

dos: Do rule every surface on the 24px row pitch and divide cells with 1px printed rules.
Do set every timecode and episode number in JetBrains Mono with tabular numerals.
Do keep red to the stop mark, its wash, timecodes, and the Resume / Jump action; use blue for finished.
Do use ink buttons for primary actions other than resuming.
Do use print cyan for what the form printed: header cells, table heads, selected filter segments.
Do keep every pencil and rule role intact on the night sheet; only the values change.
Do label header and field cells with 11px condensed caps in rule ink, paired with the value they name.
donts: Don't round corners on cells, buttons, inputs, sheets or tags.
Don't use a cream or white paper ground.
Don't build a grid of poster cards on a dark ground; posters sit inside a sheet head.
Don't use red for errors, warnings, emphasis or branding.
Don't set words in mono or numbers in proportional figures.
Don't add shadows to cells or buttons; only sheets lift and only floating slips cast shadows.
Don't put a condensed-caps label above a heading as a kicker; labels name values in cells.
